theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U V M' : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (θ' : Euclid P → ℝ) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), V ⊆ U → Measurable θ' → (∀ x, 0 ≤ θ' x) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' (μHE[k].restrict M') → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[k].restrict M'), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ' x) Q) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) ⊆ V → T ω = ∫ x in M', θ' x * ξ' x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μHE[k]) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ V → ∫⁻ x in M' ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ' x) ∂μHE[k] ≠ ∞ → ∫⁻ x in M' ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ' x) ∂μHE[k] ≤ T.massOn W
